answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 165899 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Islamic Wazifah for Healing from Psoriasis Question: Recently I had been recently diagnosed with Psorasis and I am 26 years old. I need wazifah to cure the disease from the blessing of Allah. Please my question confidential. Answer ID: 165899 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 147/121/M=03/1440) Undergo treatment of any expert doctor or hakim and read the below verse and blow on you: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَى رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِ مِن ضُرٍّ وَآتَيْنَاهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَى لِلْعَابِدِينَ [الأنبياء : 84] May Allah cure you, Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
